events.strFilename: Boxing 2026-08-08 Zuffa Boxing 10 McKenna vs Oliha
events.strDescriptionEN: A electric atmosphere builds inside the 3Arena as Zuffa Boxing lands in Dublin for a championship headliner at Zuffa Boxing 10. The primary hurdle for undefeated Irish contender Aaron McKenna is managing the immense pressure of fighting in front of his home-country fans while contesting his first career world title bout. The objective for McKenna is to leverage his height and long reach, working behind a sharp, technical jab to maintain range and break down his opponent from distance over twelve scheduled rounds. Concurrently, the mission for undefeated Italian contender Etinosa Oliha centers on closing the gap early, forcing the action into close quarters, and applying continuous inside pressure to disrupt the hometown favorite's rhythm and claim the vacant crown on away soil.

An electric atmosphere builds at Caribe Royale Resort as Most Valuable Promotions lands in Orlando for an undisputed bantamweight world championship headliner at MVPW 05. The primary hurdle for undisputed bantamweight world champion Cherneka Johnson is defending her crown against an undefeated former champion while handling the high-stakes pressure of a marquee global main card. The objective for Johnson is to work behind dynamic long-range combination punching, leveraging sharp ring generalship to dictate distance and keep the challenger at bay. Concurrently, the mission for undefeated Danish star Dina Thorslund centers on applying relentless inside pressure, closing the gap quickly, and relying on high-volume body attacks to reclaim the bantamweight throne.

events.strFilename: Boxing 2026-08-08 Emanuel Moreno vs Guillermo Gutierrez
events.strDescriptionEN: An intense atmosphere builds at El Paso County Coliseum as Red Owl Boxing lands in Texas for BOXFEST XIX, featuring a high-stakes bantamweight championship main event. The primary hurdle for undefeated titleholder Emanuel "El Trompo" Moreno is defending his regional crown while handling the pressure of headlining in front of a home-state crowd. The objective for Moreno is to set a relentless tempo, leveraging sharp jab combinations and high-volume body pressure to control the center of the ring. Concurrently, the mission for challenger Guillermo "GMO" Gutierrez centers on using precise counter-punching, exploiting openings in close quarters, and delivering impactful exchanges to dethrone the champion and claim the title.
